purpose: Phase 2 of the scrambled-history experiment: the LIVE-model counterpart of the Phase 1 scripted calibration gate. Does a real pinned model's terminal action distribution change when an identical admitted experience multiset is presented in a permuted order (A vs B), while the sham reorder control (A vs C) stays null?
primary_event: ANALYSIS IDENTITY (frozen): the Phase-2 analysis callable is metrics.order_sensitivity_report at ORDER_REPORT_VERSION 3, consuming the admissibility_policy and the thresholds frozen in THIS registry entry (bootstrap_iterations / bootstrap_seed / confidence / min_detectable_effect / permutation_iterations / permutation_seed / alpha / noise_floor_split) together with the frozen max_surviving_delta. The callable version is 3 because the DECISION RULE changed again: version 2 replaced the split-half noise floor with a PAIRED PERMUTATION null, and version 3 corrects the sensitivity requirement from a symmetric precondition gating BOTH branches to an asymmetric requirement attaching ONLY to the null branch -- so any emitted verdict stays traceable to the exact rule that produced it. NULL MODEL: for each of the 48 matched effective units (variant_id, scenario_seed, sampler_seed) present in every condition, the terminal actions of the two compared conditions are exchanged with probability one half, the total-variation distance is recomputed, and the procedure repeats for permutation_iterations under permutation_seed; the decision quantile is the 1 - alpha percentile of that null. Let q_AB and q_AC be the 1 - alpha quantiles of the paired permutation nulls for A vs B and for A vs C respectively. A percentile bootstrap (bootstrap_iterations under bootstrap_seed at confidence) is retained for REPORTING intervals on the observed distances only and decides nothing. The Phase-1 terminal-distribution comparator is explicitly NOT the Phase-2 analysis path -- it is named only in notes, never here, so that no analysis identity can ever select it: it admits parse fallbacks as decisions, and on this very candidate it returned TV(A,B) = TV(A,C) = 0.0 with all mass on a single action from 12 runs of wholly unparseable output -- a clean null produced by an instrument that parsed nothing. Freezing it here would freeze the exact unsafe path Phase 2 exists to avoid. DECISION RULE (ORDERED; the FIRST clause that matches decides, and no later clause may revise it): (1) if the admissibility policy refuses, or the seed probe fails, or digest drift is detected, or effective n falls below min_admissible_effective_n, or the per-condition surviving counts differ by more than max_surviving_delta, the verdict is inconclusive; (2) else if the observed TV(A,C) exceeds q_AC the verdict is inconclusive -- the sham is not null, which voids any order claim outright and is never rescued post hoc; (3) else if the observed TV(A,B) exceeds q_AB the verdict is ORDER EFFECT OBSERVED; (4) else if q_AB is less than or equal to min_detectable_effect the verdict is NO ORDER EFFECT OBSERVED, and the bound that null claim is entitled to state is min_detectable_effect; (5) else the verdict is inconclusive. ASYMMETRY OF THE SENSITIVITY REQUIREMENT (deliberate): the requirement q_AB <= min_detectable_effect attaches ONLY to the null branch, clause (4), and never invalidates a rejection. q_AB IS the rejection threshold of this test, so a clause (3) outcome means H0 was rejected at alpha, and that is a valid positive finding whether or not a smaller effect would also have been resolvable. Sensitivity constrains only what may be concluded from a NON-rejection, because a null claim asserts the absence of an effect at or above min_detectable_effect and is unsupportable unless the test could actually have resolved an effect of that size; a positive claim asserts only that this comparison rejected, and needs no such warrant. Reaching clause (3) therefore requires exactly two things and nothing more: that the observed TV(A,C) does NOT exceed q_AC, and that the observed TV(A,B) exceeds q_AB. The superseded symmetric formulation, which gated BOTH branches on min_detectable_effect, was measured perverse: at total separation over near-two-point support, TV(A,B) = 1.0 against q_AB = 0.2917 -- a decisive rejection -- was reported inconclusive solely because 0.2917 > 0.25, discarding a maximal unambiguous effect. An inconclusive from clause (5) means the pack neither rejected H0 nor earned the right to assert absence: it is NOT evidence of absence and must never be reported as a null result. DIAGNOSTIC ONLY: noise_floor_split remains frozen and design-hashed and TV_null = TV(A|S1, A|S2) is still computed and still reported, but purely as a within-condition stability DIAGNOSTIC. It gates NO verdict, decides NO branch of this rule, and no future reader may treat it as decisive.
notes: Live runs are NOT authorized by this pre-registration: executing any run of this design requires owner SC-6 approval bound to the exact design hash, candidate commit, model digest, run count, and budget. A design AUDIT_GO is not permission to contact a provider. Prerequisite: the Phase 1 scripted calibration (m7-scrambled-history-gate, events 001714/001719/001724) must have PASSED before any Phase 2 run is scheduled. The model digest is part of the hashed regime: a digest change is a NEW regime whose runs NEVER pool with Phase 1 or with earlier Phase 2 runs; this is an abliterated (refusal-suppressed) build and every claim is scoped to that regime. 1 model x 3 scenarios x 2 scenario_seeds x 24 sampler_seeds = 144 runs (48 effective units per condition). retries_per_unit 0: a failed unit is a typed outcome, never a re-roll. The whole pack must execute against a single Ollama host and backend version. Conditions must be interleaved, not blocked. Preflight: scenario.lint_scramble_triplet must return [] before any run. NAMED ANALYSIS EXCLUSION: the Phase-1 comparator metrics.scramble_terminal_distribution may NOT be used to analyse this experiment; it is named here rather than in primary_event so that the analysis-identity lint can ban the symbol from primary_event outright instead of trying to parse an English negation. DROPOUT BOUND: max_surviving_delta = 2 is the absolute spread permitted between per-condition surviving counts, loaded from the frozen registry entry; a Phase-2 pack must be unable to complete an analysis without it. AMENDMENT PROVENANCE: min_detectable_effect, max_surviving_delta and the analysis identity were added by the audit repair loop while this design was still an unfrozen candidate -- no outcome exists, no live run has occurred and no model has been contacted; two bounds are ADDED and the analysis path is narrowed to the safer one. NULL-MODEL REPLACEMENT (second audit repair, still pre-execution): the split-half noise floor was replaced by a PAIRED PERMUTATION null (permutation_iterations = 10000, permutation_seed = 20260719, alpha = 0.05). The required characterisation, run BEFORE any execution, measured the split-half rule INERT -- false-positive rate 0.000 AND power 0.000, because TV_null between two 24-unit halves carries about twice the small-sample inflation of TV(A,B) on 48 against 48, putting the floor near 0.49 against a 0.25 ceiling. noise_floor_split is RETAINED, still frozen and design-hashed and still computed, but purely as a reported DIAGNOSTIC of within-condition stability: it gates no verdict. No outcome exists, no live run has occurred and no model has been contacted; this preregistration itself REQUIRES that an underpowered design be corrected before execution rather than reinterpreted after. SENSITIVITY-ASYMMETRY CORRECTION (third audit repair, still pre-execution; ORDER_REPORT_VERSION bumped 2 -> 3): the sensitivity requirement q_AB <= min_detectable_effect had been specified as a precondition gating BOTH branches of the decision rule, carried over from the superseded split-half null without re-derivation. Under a split-half null an inflated floor genuinely broke both directions; under a paired permutation null it does not, because q_AB IS the rejection threshold, so exceeding it rejects H0 at alpha regardless of whether a smaller effect would also have been resolvable. Implemented symmetrically the rule was perverse: total separation with TV(A,B) = 1.0 against q_AB = 0.2917 returned inconclusive solely because 0.2917 > 0.25, discarding a decisive rejection. The requirement now attaches ONLY to the null branch and never invalidates a rejection. Nothing is weakened: the sham gate, the admissibility policy, the effective-n floor and max_surviving_delta all still gate every branch, and the null branch still carries the full sensitivity warrant. No outcome exists, no live run has occurred and no model has been contacted.
